description: This file defines the 'DeleteFeatureProperty' command class which models a command to delete a specific property from a feature of a thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for instantiation from JSON, accessors, and serialization logic. It is a key part of the command pattern implementation in the project.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureProperty
classes.description: An immutable command class representing a request to delete a specific property from a feature of a thing, with methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing properties, and serializing the command.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeleteFeatureProperty command with a ThingId, feature ID, property pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteFeatureProperty from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the property to delete.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing to which this command applies.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the path of the resource to be affected.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization permissions (false in this case).

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the command object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on internal fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, confirms other object can be considered equal.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command object.
